title: music.search
description: Search Spotify's track catalog. Returns the top matches as { tracks: [{ name, artist, uri }], fetched_at_ms }. Needs a valid token (the auth path may open the browser grant on first use) but no active device. Denies by name: music_bad_query (missing/empty), music_no_client_id, music_auth_*.

limit.description: Number of tracks to return. Default 5; clamped to 1-20.
